cohort: Singletons born to women who underwent 0PN, 1PN, or 2PN vitrified-warmed single blastocyst transfers between 2012 and 2021.
finding: The transfer of 0PN and 1PN blastocysts did not compromise reproductive outcomes or increase maternal and perinatal complications compared to 2PN blastocyst transfers.
mod_finding: Maternal complications and mode of delivery were comparable between the 0PN and 2PN study cohorts, and no significant differences in maternal outcomes (including mode of delivery) were found between the 1PN and 2PN groups.
